# bmad-skills

Packaged [BMAD Method](https://github.com/bmad-code-org/BMAD-METHOD) skills.

Every file in this repository is build output, generated from
`bmad-code-org/BMAD-METHOD` by its packager when a Method release is
published. The whole tree is replaced on each release and tagged with the
Method version.

**Do not edit.** Nothing here is authored by hand; pull requests will be
closed. Skills are authored in
[BMAD-METHOD](https://github.com/bmad-code-org/BMAD-METHOD) — changes belong
there.

## Install

```
npx skills add bmad-code-org/bmad-skills
```

> Status: prototype. No release has been published here yet; the `skills/`
> tree appears with the first published Method release.
